component.name: Oxipod
component.summary: Put music on your old iPod

description.p: Oxipod adds music to iPods that sync through iTunes, without needing iTunes. Plug in your iPod, drop your music on the window, and it's ready to play.

ul.li: Add songs and whole folders by dragging them onto the window
Converts FLAC, Opus, Ogg, WAV and other formats to MP3 automatically
Copies cover art from the file or from a cover image in the album folder
Search the songs and sort them by title, artist, album or date added
Create playlists and add or remove songs
Delete songs from the iPod, one at a time or several at once
Copy songs back to your computer with readable file names
Finds and cleans up leftover files from interrupted syncs

description.p: Oxipod is built on libgpod, so it should work with the iPods libgpod supports, like the iPod classic, the mini and the nano up to the 4th generation. So far it has only been tested with the iPod nano 3rd generation. The touchscreen nano (6th and 7th generation), the iPod touch and iPhones are not supported.

screenshot.caption: The songs on an iPod nano

description.p: You can now copy songs from the iPod back to your computer.

ul.li: Copy to Computer in the menu of a song, or for a whole selection, with names like "Artist - Title.mp3"
Nothing gets overwritten, and songs that are already in the folder are skipped
The list of iPods no longer shows where the iPod is mounted
A softer placeholder for songs without cover art

description.p: The song list is a lot faster with big libraries, and you can now search and sort it.

ul.li: Sort by title, artist, album or when you added them
Select All only ticks the songs the search shows
No more GLib warnings when ejecting

description.p: Select several songs at once to delete them or add them to a playlist.
